en.s: The Battle of Trapani was a naval battle that took place on 23 June 1266 off Trapani, Sicily, between the fleets of the Republic of Genoa and the Republic of Venice, as part of the War of Saint Sabas (1256–1270). During the war, the Venetians held the upper hand in naval confrontations, forcing the Genoese to resort to commerce raiding and avoiding fleet battles.

zh.s: 特拉帕尼海战于1266年6月23日在西西里岛特拉帕尼附近爆发，交战双方是热那亚共和国和威尼斯共和国的舰队，属于圣萨巴斯战争（1256—1270年）。战争期间，威尼斯在海战中占据上风，热那亚因此转而袭击商船，避免与威尼斯舰队正面交战。

en.s: The Battle of Moclín, also known as the Disaster of Moclín, was a battle fought in the Granadian municipality of Moclín on June 23, 1280. The battle pitted the troops of the Emirate of Granada, commanded by Muhammad II, the Sultan of Granada, against those of the Kingdom of Castile and the Kingdom of Leon who were composed mainly of mercenaries and of members of the Order of Santiago, being commanded by the contemporary grand master of the order Gonzalo Ruiz Girón and by the infante Sancho, son of King Alfonso X of Castile.

zh.s: 莫克林战役也称莫克林惨败，于1280年6月23日在格拉纳达莫克林市镇爆发。交战双方是由格拉纳达苏丹穆罕默德二世指挥的格拉纳达埃米尔国军队，以及卡斯蒂利亚王国和莱昂王国军队。后者主要由雇佣兵和圣地亚哥骑士团成员组成，由骑士团团长贡萨洛·鲁伊斯·希龙和卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索十世之子桑乔王子指挥。

en.s: The naval Battle of the Counts took place on 23 June 1287 at Naples, Italy, when an Aragonese-Sicilian galley fleet commanded by Roger of Lauria defeated a large combined Angevin (Apulian and Principatan) galley fleet commanded respectively by Reynald III Quarrel and Narjot de Toucy. Lauria had taken his fleet to Augusta, eastern Sicily, after a report of an Angevin galley fleets landing invasion troops there. He landed his troops, who recaptured the town, leaving the Angevins holed up in the castle. However, the invasion was a decoy and the Angevin galleys had sailed around the south of Sicily and linked up with their allies, forming a fleet about twice the size of Lauria's.

zh.s: 伯爵海战于1287年6月23日在意大利那不勒斯附近爆发。罗杰·德·劳里亚指挥的阿拉贡-西西里桨帆船舰队击败了安茹联军桨帆船舰队，后者由雷纳尔德三世·克雷尔和纳尔若·德·图西分别指挥。劳里亚此前听说安茹军队在西西里东部的奥古斯塔登陆，于是率舰队赶到当地并派兵夺回该镇，安茹军队退守城堡。但这次入侵只是佯攻，安茹桨帆船已绕过西西里岛南端，与盟友会合，舰队规模约为劳里亚舰队的两倍。

en.s: The Treaty of Athis-sur-Orge was a peace treaty signed on 23 June 1305 between King Philip IV of France and Robert III of Flanders. The treaty was signed at Athis-sur-Orge after the Battle of Mons-en-Pévèle and concluded the Franco-Flemish War (1297–1305). Despite winning the battle at Mons-en-Pévèle, Philip's kingdom was too financially and militarily drained to take advantage of it. The treaty instead imposed a heavy price.

zh.s: 阿蒂-叙尔-奥尔日条约是法国国王腓力四世与佛兰德斯伯爵罗伯特三世于1305年6月23日签署的一项和平条约。条约在蒙桑佩韦勒战役后于阿蒂-叙尔-奥尔日签订，结束了1297年至1305年的法兰德斯战争。尽管腓力在战役中获胜，但其王国已在财政和军事上疲惫不堪，无法利用胜势；条约最终仍附带沉重代价。

en.s: The Knights Hospitaller, led by Grand Master Foulques de Villaret, landed on Rhodes in summer 1306 and quickly conquered most of it except for the city of Rhodes, which remained in Byzantine hands. Emperor Andronikos II Palaiologos sent reinforcements, which allowed the city to repel the initial Hospitaller attacks, and persevere until it was captured on 15 August 1310.

en.s: The Battle of Bannockburn (Scottish Gaelic: Blàr Allt nam Bànag or Blàr Allt a' Bhonnaich) was fought on 23–24 June 1314, between the army of Robert the Bruce, King of Scots, and the army of King Edward II of England, during the First War of Scottish Independence. It was a decisive victory for Robert Bruce and formed a major turning point in the war, which ended 14 years later with the de jure restoration of Scottish independence under the Treaty of Edinburgh–Northampton.

zh.s: 班诺克本战役于1314年6月23日至24日爆发，交战双方是苏格兰国王罗伯特·布鲁斯的军队和英格兰国王爱德华二世的军队，属于第一次苏格兰独立战争。罗伯特·布鲁斯取得决定性胜利，战役成为战争的重要转折点。14年后，《爱丁堡—北安普顿条约》在法律上恢复了苏格兰独立。

en.s: The Battle of La Rochelle was a naval battle fought on 22 and 23 June 1372 between a Franco-Castilian fleet commanded by the Castilian Almirant Ambrosio Boccanegra and an English convoy commanded by John Hastings, 2nd Earl of Pembroke. The Franco-Castilian fleet had been sent to attack the English at La Rochelle, which was being besieged by French forces. Besides Boccanegra, other Castilian commanders were Cabeza de Vaca, Fernando de Peón and the Basque Ruy Díaz de Rojas. Pembroke had been dispatched to the town with a small retinue of 160 soldiers and instructions to recruit an army of 3,000 soldiers around Aquitaine.

zh.s: 拉罗谢尔海战于1372年6月22日至23日爆发，交战双方是安布罗西奥·博卡内格拉指挥的法-卡斯蒂利亚舰队，以及彭布罗克伯爵约翰·黑斯廷斯指挥的英国船队。法军当时正围攻拉罗谢尔，法-卡斯蒂利亚舰队奉命攻击英国船队。卡斯蒂利亚其他指挥官包括卡贝萨·德·巴卡、费尔南多·德·佩翁和巴斯克人鲁伊·迪亚斯·德·罗哈斯。彭布罗克率160名士兵抵达当地，并奉命在阿基坦招募3000名士兵。

en.s: The Battle of Kokenhausen (Kokenhuza, Latvian: Koknese) was a major battle opening the Polish–Swedish War (1600–1611). It took place on the 23 June 1601 near Koknese in Livonia (now in Latvia). In the battle, Polish forces defeated the Swedish relief force and captured the besieging force, relieving the Polish garrison. The battle is notable as one of the greatest victories of the Polish hussars, who defeated their numerically superior Swedish adversaries.

zh.s: 科肯豪森战役（拉脱维亚语：Koknese）是1600年至1611年波瑞战争爆发之初的一场重要战役，于1601年6月23日在利沃尼亚科克内塞（今拉脱维亚）附近进行。波兰军队击败瑞典援军，俘获围城部队，解救了波兰守军。这场战役是波兰翼骑兵的重要胜利之一；尽管瑞典军人数更多，仍遭击败。

en.s: The Battle of Plassey was a decisive victory of the British East India Company over the Nawab of Bengal and his French allies on 23 June 1757. The battle consolidated the Company's presence in Bengal, which later expanded to cover much of India over the next hundred years. The battle took place at Palashi (Anglicised version: Plassey) on the banks of the Bhagirathi River, about 150 kilometres (93 mi) north of Calcutta and south of Murshidabad, then capital of Bengal (now in Nadia district in West Bengal). The belligerents were the Nawab Siraj-ud-daulah, the last independent Nawab of Bengal, and the British East India Company.

zh.s: 普拉西战役于1757年6月23日爆发，是英国东印度公司对孟加拉纳瓦卜及其法国盟友取得的一场决定性胜利。战役巩固了东印度公司在孟加拉的势力，之后百年间公司控制范围扩展到印度大部分地区。战斗发生在巴吉拉蒂河畔的帕拉希（英文名Plassey），距加尔各答以北约150公里（93英里），在当时的孟加拉首府穆尔希达巴德以南，今属西孟加拉邦纳迪亚县。交战双方是孟加拉最后一任独立纳瓦卜西拉杰·乌德·道拉及英国东印度公司。

en.s: The Battle of Landeshut was an engagement fought on 23 June 1760 during the Seven Years' War. A Prussian army of 12,000 men under General Heinrich August de la Motte Fouqué fought an Austrian army of over 28,000 men under General von Loudon and suffered a defeat, with its commander taken prisoner.

en.s: The Battle of Springfield was fought during the American Revolutionary War on June 23, 1780. After the Battle of Connecticut Farms, on June 7, 1780, had foiled Lieutenant General Wilhelm, Baron von Knyphausen’s expedition to attack General George Washington’s army at Morristown, New Jersey, Knyphausen and Lieutenant General Sir Henry Clinton, British commander-in-chief in North America, decided upon a second attempt. Although the British were initially able to advance, they were ultimately forced to withdraw in the face of newly arriving colonial forces, resulting in a Continental victory.

zh.s: 斯普林菲尔德战役于1780年6月23日爆发，属于美国独立战争。1780年6月7日，康涅狄格农场战役挫败了威廉·冯·克尼法森中将进攻新泽西州莫里斯敦乔治·华盛顿军队的计划。克尼法森与北美英军总司令亨利·克林顿爵士中将随后决定再次进攻。英军起初得以推进，但随着殖民地军队陆续赶到，最终被迫撤退，大陆军获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Groix was a large naval engagement which took place off the island of Groix on the Biscay coast of Brittany on 23 June 1795 (5 messidor an III) during the French Revolutionary Wars. The battle was fought between elements of the British Channel Fleet and the French Atlantic Fleet, which were both cruising in the region on separate missions. The British fleet, commanded by Admiral Lord Bridport was covering an invasion convoy carrying a French Royalist army to invade Quiberon, while the French under Vice-Admiral Villaret de Joyeuse had sailed a week earlier to rescue a French convoy from attack by a British squadron.

zh.s: 格鲁瓦海战于1795年6月23日（共和历三年牧月五日）在布列塔尼比斯开湾海岸外、格鲁瓦岛附近爆发，是法国大革命战争期间一场大规模海战。交战双方是正在当地执行不同任务的英国海峡舰队和法国大西洋舰队。布里奇波特勋爵海军上将指挥的英国舰队负责护送一支载有法国保王党军队、准备入侵基伯龙的船队；维拉雷·德·茹瓦耶斯海军中将指挥的法国舰队则在一周前出航，试图营救遭英国分舰队攻击的法国船队。

en.s: The Battle of Cogorderos took place at Cogorderos, in the Province of León, Castile-León, on 23 June 1811, between a French force under Brigadier General Jean-André Valletaux and a Spanish force commanded by General Francisco Taboada y Gil during the Peninsular War. After seven hours of battle, the French were defeated and retreated to León. Despite the victory, Taboada, threatened by the bulk of General Jean Pierre François Bonet's army, retired to Astorga.

zh.s: 科戈德罗斯战役于1811年6月23日在卡斯蒂利亚-莱昂自治区莱昂省科戈德罗斯爆发，交战双方是让-安德烈·瓦莱托准将指挥的法军和弗朗西斯科·塔博阿达·希尔将军指挥的西班牙军，属于半岛战争。经过7小时战斗，法军战败并撤退至莱昂。塔博阿达虽获胜，但因让·皮埃尔·弗朗索瓦·博内将军的大部队逼近，仍撤至阿斯托加。

en.s: The siege of Silistria, or siege of Silistra, was a key engagement in the Crimean War, fought from 11 May to 23 June 1854 between the Russian Empire and the Ottoman Empire in present-day Bulgaria. The Russian army, numbering up to 90,000 men with 266 guns, attempted to capture the Danubian fortress of Silistria as part of a broader strategy to outflank Ottoman defences and pre-empt an expected Allied landing at Varna.

en.t: The United States Congress establishes the Government Printing Office
en.s: The United States Government Publishing Office (USGPO or GPO), formerly the United States Government Printing Office, is an agency of the legislative branch of the United States federal government. The office produces and distributes information products and services for all three branches of the federal government, including U.S. passports for the Department of State as well as the official publications of the Supreme Court, Congress, the Executive Office of the President, executive departments, and independent agencies.

zh.s: 美国政府出版局（USGPO或GPO，原名美国政府印刷局）是美国联邦政府立法部门的机构。它为联邦政府行政、立法和司法三大部门制作并发行信息产品与服务，包括美国国务院护照，以及最高法院、国会、总统行政办公室、行政部门和独立机构的官方出版物。

en.t: The International Olympic Committee is founded at the Sorbonne in Paris, at the initiative of Baron Pierre de Coubertin
en.s: The International Olympic Committee (IOC) is the international, non-governmental, sports governing body of the modern Olympic Games. Founded in 1894 by Pierre de Coubertin and Demetrios Vikelas, it is based in Lausanne, Switzerland. The IOC is the authority responsible for organising the Summer, Winter, and Youth Olympics. The IOC is also the governing body of the National Olympic Committees (NOCs) and the worldwide Olympic Movement, which includes all entities and individuals involved in the Olympic Games.

zh.t: 国际奥林匹克委员会在巴黎索邦大学成立
zh.s: 国际奥林匹克委员会（IOC）是现代奥运会的国际非政府体育管理机构，于1894年6月23日在巴黎索邦大学成立，创办者包括皮埃尔·德·顾拜旦和德米特里奥斯·维凯拉斯，现总部设在瑞士洛桑。IOC负责组织夏季奥运会、冬季奥运会和青年奥运会，也负责管理各国奥委会及包括奥运会所有相关机构和人员在内的奥林匹克运动。

en.s: The Canadian federal election of 1896 was held on June 23, 1896 to elect members of the Canadian House of Commons of the 8th Parliament of Canada. Though the Conservative Party won a plurality of the popular vote, the Liberal Party, led by Wilfrid Laurier, won the majority of seats to form the next government. The governing Conservative Party, since the death of John A. Macdonald in 1891, was disorganized, going through four leaders in five years. The party was also viewed as corrupt and wasteful of public funds. Issues like the Manitoba Schools Question had cost the party support in both French and English Canada.

zh.s: 1896年加拿大联邦大选于1896年6月23日举行，选出加拿大第八届议会下议院议员。保守党的普选得票最多，但威尔弗里德·劳里埃领导的自由党获得多数席位并组建新政府。自约翰·A·麦克唐纳于1891年去世后，保守党组织混乱，五年内更换了四位党魁。该党还被视为腐败、浪费公帑，并因曼尼托巴学校问题等议题失去法语和英语选民的支持。

en.s: The Battle of Doiran was a battle of the Second Balkan War, fought between the Bulgaria and Greece. The battle took place in June 1913. The Hellenic Army, after the victory at Kilkis-Lachanas, continued their advance north and successfully engaged the Bulgarians at Lake Doiran. The Bulgarian army had retreated to the lake, after having destroyed the bridges of Strymon River and burned the town of Serres.

en.s: The Battle of Zacatecas, also known as the Toma de Zacatecas ("Taking of Zacatecas"), was the bloodiest battle in the campaign to overthrow Mexican President Victoriano Huerta. On June 23, 1914, Pancho Villa's División del Norte (Division of the North) decisively defeated the federal troops of General Luis Medina Barrón defending the town of Zacatecas. The great victory demoralized Huerta's supporters, leading to his resignation on July 15.

zh.s: 萨卡特卡斯战役也称“攻占萨卡特卡斯”，是推翻墨西哥总统维多里亚诺·韦尔塔行动中最血腥的一场战斗。1914年6月23日，潘乔·比利亚率领北方师，在萨卡特卡斯击败路易斯·梅迪纳·巴龙将军指挥的联邦军。大获全胜令韦尔塔的支持者士气低落，韦尔塔于7月15日辞职。

en.s: The battle of Konary took place during the Great War, in May and June 1915 in the Sandomierz Uplands, near the village of Konary and the town of Klimontów, Poland, between the Russian Army and the forces of Józef Piłsudski's Polish Legions. The battle started on 16 May, when the Russian 4th Army started its counter-offensive against the Central Powers in the Kingdom of Poland.

en.s: The Battle of Bukoba was the first victory for Entente forces in German East Africa, coming after the disastrous battles of Tanga and Jassin. The British objective was the destruction of the Bukoba wireless station. Due to Bukoba's location on the shore of Lake Victoria, it was decided that the raid should take the form of an amphibious assault.

en.t: Second Battle of the Piave River
en.s: The Second Battle of the Piave River (or Battle of the Solstice), fought between 15 and 23 June 1918, was a decisive victory for the Italian Army against the Austro-Hungarian Empire during World War I, as Italy was part of the Allied Forces, while Austria-Hungary was part of the Central Powers.

zh.s: 皮亚韦河第二次战役也称夏至战役，于1918年6月15日至23日爆发。第一次世界大战期间，意大利军队击败奥匈帝国军队，取得决定性胜利。意大利属于协约国，奥匈帝国属于同盟国。

en.s: The 1919 Quebec general election was held on June 23, 1919, to elect members of the 15th Legislative Assembly of Quebec, Canada. The incumbent Quebec Liberal Party, led by Lomer Gouin, was re-elected, defeating the Quebec Conservative Party, led by Arthur Sauvé. Gouin, who had held office since 1905, resigned precisely one year after the election to make way for his successor Louis-Alexandre Taschereau.

zh.s: 1919年魁北克省大选于1919年6月23日举行，选出加拿大魁北克省第15届立法议会议员。洛梅尔·古安领导的执政魁北克自由党连任，击败阿瑟·索韦领导的魁北克保守党。古安自1905年起担任省长，并在选举整整一年后辞职，由路易-亚历山大·塔舍罗接任。

en.s: The Battle of Cēsis (Latvian: Cēsu kaujas; Estonian: Võnnu lahing, Battle of Võnnu; German: Schlacht von Wenden, Battle of Wenden), fought near Cēsis (Wenden) in June 1919, was a decisive battle in the Estonian War of Independence and the Latvian War of Independence. After heavy fighting, an Estonian force moving from the north, supplemented by Latvian units, repelled Baltic German attacks and went on a full counter-attack.

en.s: The Shameen Incident or the Shameen Attack occurred on June 23, 1925, and is also commonly referred to by the Chinese side as the Shaji Massacre. It was an armed conflict that took place in Canton City. During the incident, British and French soldiers opened fire on a demonstration march along Shaji Road, resulting in severe civilian casualties on the Chinese side.

zh.s: 沙基惨案又称沙面事件，发生于1925年6月23日的广州。英国和法国士兵向沿沙基路行进的示威队伍开枪，造成中国民众严重伤亡。

en.s: The Irish general election of 1943 was held on 23 June 1943. The 138 newly elected members of the 11th Dáil assembled on 1 July when the new Taoiseach and government were appointed. Fianna Fáil remained in power, but had lost their parliamentary majority. The general election took place in 34 parliamentary constituencies throughout Ireland for 138 seats in the lower house of parliament, Dáil Éireann. The election was fought while the Emergency Powers Act 1939 was still in force.

zh.s: 爱尔兰大选于1943年6月23日举行。新当选的第11届众议院138名议员于7月1日开会，任命新总理和政府。共和党继续执政，但失去了议会多数。选举在爱尔兰全国34个选区举行，选出下议院众议院138名议员。当时《1939年紧急权力法》仍在实施。

en.s: The Battle of Lababia Ridge was fought from 20–23 June 1943 in the Territory of New Guinea during World War II. Part of the Salamaua–Lae campaign, the battle involved Australian and Japanese troops who clashed on the ridge, which was about 20 kilometres (12 mi) south of Salamaua, near Mubo, over the course of several days.

en.s: In the evening of June 23, 1944, a powerful F4 tornado devastated northern West Virginia, particularly the town of Shinnston. The tornado killed at least 100 people and injured hundreds more. This tornado was the deadliest in West Virginia history and at least the 14th deadliest in US history. It is the only tornado to produce violent damage in the state's history.

zh.s: 1944年6月23日傍晚，一场强烈的F4级龙卷风袭击西弗吉尼亚州北部，欣斯顿镇受灾尤为严重。龙卷风造成至少100人死亡、数百人受伤，是西弗吉尼亚州历史上死亡人数最多的龙卷风；按死亡人数计算，在美国历史上至少排第14位。这是该州历史上唯一造成严重破坏的龙卷风。

en.s: The Mogilev offensive (Russian: Могилевская наступательная операция) was part of the Belorussian strategic offensive – commonly known as Operation Bagration – of the Red Army on the Eastern Front of World War II in the summer of 1944. Its goals were to capture the city of Mogilev and to pin down and trap the bulk of the German Fourth Army. The offensive fulfilled both objectives.

en.s: The 1946 Vancouver Island earthquake struck Vancouver Island on the coast of British Columbia, Canada, on June 23 at 10:15 a.m. with a magnitude estimated at 7.0 Ms and 7.5 Mw. The main shock epicenter occurred in the Forbidden Plateau area northwest of Courtenay. While most of the large earthquakes in the Vancouver area occur at tectonic plate boundaries, the 1946 Vancouver Island earthquake was a crustal event.
en.n: The 1946 Vancouver Island earthquake strikes Vancouver Island, British Columbia, Canada.

zh.s: 1946年6月23日上午10时15分，加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省沿岸的温哥华岛发生地震，估计面波震级为7.0级、矩震级为7.5级。主震震中位于科特尼西北部的禁区高原地区。温哥华地区大多数强震发生在板块边界上，而1946年温哥华岛地震属于地壳内地震。

en.s: The Labor Management Relations Act, 1947, better known as the Taft–Hartley Act, is a United States federal law that restricts the activities and power of labor unions. It was enacted by the 80th United States Congress over the veto of President Harry S. Truman, becoming law on June 23, 1947. The Taft–Hartley Act was introduced in the aftermath of a major strike wave in 1945 and 1946.

en.s: A double referendum was held in Egypt on 23 June 1956. The two issues were the candidacy of Gamal Abdel Nasser for the presidency and a new constitution. Both were approved, with the official figures showing 99.9% in favour of Nasser's candidacy and 99.8% in favour of the constitution.

en.t: Convicted Manhattan Project spy Klaus Fuchs is released after only nine years in prison and allowed to emigrate to Dresden, East Germany where he resumes a scientific career
en.s: Klaus Emil Julius Fuchs (29 December 1911 – 28 January 1988) was a German theoretical physicist, atomic spy, and communist who supplied information from the American, British, and Canadian Manhattan Project to the Soviet Union during and shortly after World War II. While at the Los Alamos Laboratory, Fuchs was responsible for many significant theoretical calculations relating to the first nuclear weapons and, later, early models of the hydrogen bomb.

zh.s: 克劳斯·埃米尔·尤利乌斯·富克斯（1911年12月29日—1988年1月28日）是德国理论物理学家、原子间谍和共产主义者。二战期间及战后不久，他将美国、英国和加拿大曼哈顿计划的情报提供给苏联。在洛斯阿拉莫斯实验室期间，他负责多项首批核武器的重要理论计算，后来也参与早期氢弹模型的计算。

en.t: The Antarctic Treaty enters into force
en.s: On June 23, 1961, the Antarctic Treaty entered into force. It reserves Antarctica for peaceful purposes, protects scientific cooperation and limits military activity. The wider Antarctic Treaty System also includes later agreements.
en.n: The original Antarctic Treaty took effect on this date; later agreements form part of the wider treaty system.

zh.s: 1961年6月23日，《南极条约》生效。条约规定南极洲只用于和平目的，保障科学合作，并限制军事活动。后来签订的相关协定与这份条约共同构成南极条约体系。
zh.n: 当天生效的是《南极条约》本身；整个条约体系还包括后来签订的协定。

en.s: The 1965 Inter-Cities Fairs Cup final was the final of the seventh Inter-Cities Fairs Cup and the second of two that were not played over two legs. It was played on 23 June 1965 between Ferencváros of Hungary and Juventus of Italy. Ferencváros won the tie 1–0. Juve, with a lower physical level than their Hungarian opponents as a result of the demanding season in Serie A, played the match without two of its best players, Sivori and Salvadore.

zh.s: 1965年城市博览会杯决赛决出了第七届赛事冠军。这是该项赛事第二次只进行一场决赛，而非主客场两回合制。比赛于1965年6月23日举行，匈牙利费伦茨瓦罗斯对阵意大利尤文图斯。费伦茨瓦罗斯以1比0获胜。高强度意甲赛季过后，尤文图斯的体能状态不如对手，且两名主力球员西沃里和萨尔瓦多雷缺阵。

en.s: The 1966 Manitoba general election was held on June 23, 1966, to elect Members of the Legislative Assembly of the Province of Manitoba, Canada. It resulted in a third consecutive majority win for the Progressive Conservative Party led by Dufferin Roblin. Roblin's Tories won 31 seats, against 14 for the Liberal Party, 11 for the New Democratic Party and one for Social Credit.

en.s: The Glassboro Summit Conference, usually just called the Glassboro Summit, was the 23–25 June 1967 meeting of the heads of government of the United States and the Soviet Union—President Lyndon B. Johnson and Premier Alexei Kosygin, respectively—for the purpose of discussing Soviet Union–United States relations in Glassboro, New Jersey, US. During the Arab–Israeli Six-Day War, diplomatic contact and cooperation increased, leading some to hope for an improvement in the two countries' relations.

zh.s: 格拉斯伯勒峰会于1967年6月23日至25日举行，美国总统林登·约翰逊与苏联部长会议主席阿列克谢·柯西金在美国新泽西州格拉斯伯勒会晤，讨论美苏关系。六日战争期间，双方外交接触与合作有所增加，一些人因此期待两国关系改善。

en.t: Seventy-four people were killed and 150 others injured in a stampede at a football match between Boca Juniors and Club Atlético River Plate in Buenos Aires, Argentina
en.s: The Tragedy of Gate 12 (Spanish: La tragedia de la puerta 12) was a fatal human stampede that occurred on June 23, 1968, at the River Plate Stadium in Buenos Aires, Argentina. Over 70 people, all of them Boca Juniors fans with an average age of 19, were crushed to death, and more than 200 others were injured as they attempted to leave the stadium following a match between River Plate and their arch-rivals Boca Juniors.

zh.s: 12号闸门惨案（西班牙语：La tragedia de la puerta 12）是一起致命踩踏事故，于1968年6月23日在阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯的河床体育场发生。河床与宿敌博卡青年比赛结束后，球迷试图离开球场，超过70名博卡青年球迷被挤压致死，平均年龄为19岁，另有200多人受伤。

en.s: The 1971 Saskatchewan general election was held on June 23, 1971, to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of Saskatchewan. Under the leadership of Allan Blakeney, the New Democratic Party of Saskatchewan returned to power after seven years in opposition. The NDP won a majority government, increasing its share of the popular vote by over 10 percentage points.

en.s: Title IX is a landmark federal civil rights law in the United States that was enacted as part (Title IX) of the Education Amendments of 1972. It prohibits sex-based discrimination in any school or any other education program that receives funding from the federal government. This is Public Law No. 92‑318, 86 Stat. 235 (June 23, 1972), codified at 20 U.S.C. §§ 1681–1688.

en.s: The 1973 DFB-Pokal final, which decided the winner of the 1972–73 DFB-Pokal, took place on 23 June 1973 between Borussia Mönchengladbach and 1. FC Köln in the Rheinstadion in Düsseldorf. en.s: The 1985 Narita International Airport bombing was the attempted terrorist bombing of Air India Flight 301, which took place on June 23, 1985. en.s: Presidential elections were held in Belarus on 23 June 1994, with a second round on 10 July. They were the first national elections held in Belarus since the country seceded from the Soviet Union three years earlier. The result was a victory for Alexander Lukashenko, who received 80.6% of the vote in the second round. Voter turnout was 79.0% in the first round and 70.6% in the second. To date, this has been the only free and fair national election ever held in Belarus. Over the next two years, Lukashenko increased his power step by step, to the point that by 1996 he effectively held all governing power in the nation.

zh.s: 白俄罗斯于1994年6月23日举行总统选举，第二轮投票于7月10日进行。这是白俄罗斯脱离苏联三年后首次举行全国选举。亚历山大·卢卡申科在第二轮中以80.6%的得票率获胜。首轮投票率为79.0%，第二轮为70.6%。迄今为止，这是白俄罗斯唯一一次自由、公正的全国选举。此后两年间，卢卡申科逐步扩大权力，到1996年时实际上掌握了国家全部治理权。

en.t: NASA dedicates Space Station Processing Facility at Kennedy Space Center
en.s: NASA dedicated its Space Station Processing Facility at Kennedy Space Center in Florida on June 23, 1994. The building was designed for checking and preparing space station hardware before flight, with clean rooms, laboratories and control areas. It later processed components for the International Space Station, which was still being planned under an earlier program name at the time of dedication.
en.n: June 23 marks the facility's dedication ceremony; construction began earlier and station components were processed later.

zh.t: NASA肯尼迪航天中心的空间站处理设施启用
zh.s: 1994年6月23日，美国国家航空航天局在佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心为“空间站处理设施”举行启用仪式。这栋建筑设有洁净室、实验室和控制区，用于航天器部件发射前的检查与准备。后来，国际空间站的部分设备也在这里处理。
zh.n: 6月23日是设施举行启用仪式的日期，建设和实际处理空间站部件是不同阶段。

en.s: King of the Ring (1996) was the fourth annual King of the Ring professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF), now known as WWE. The event took place on June 23, 1996, from the MECCA Arena, now known as UW–Milwaukee Panther Arena, in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. The main event was a standard wrestling match for the WWF World Heavyweight Championship. Shawn Michaels defeated British Bulldog to retain the title, with Mr. Perfect serving as the special guest enforcer. The undercard featured the 1996 King of the Ring tournament, won by Stone Cold Steve Austin.

en.t: American social news and discussion site Reddit is founded in Medford, Massachusetts by Steve Huffman and Alexis Ohanian
en.s: Reddit ( RED-it, stylized reddit) is a proprietary American social news website, news aggregator, forum and social media platform. Registered users (commonly referred to as "redditors") submit content to the site such as links, text posts, images, and videos, which are then voted up or down ("upvoted" or "downvoted") by other members. en.s: Ashton James Eaton (born January 21, 1988) is a retired American decathlete and two-time Olympic champion, who previously held the world record in the decathlon and indoor heptathlon event. en.s: Prisión Fatal (June 2013) was an annually recurring major professional wrestling event, produced by the Mexico based International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG) professional wrestling promotion. The event took on June 23, 2013, at "Arena Naucalpan" in Naucalpan, State of Mexico, IWRG's main venue. The show was the third overall show promoted under the Prisión Fatal name and the first of two shows in 2014 billed as Prisión Fatal. en.s: The 2013 Nanga Parbat massacre was a terrorist attack that took place on the night of 22 June 2013 in Gilgit–Baltistan, Pakistan. About 16 terrorists, reportedly dressed in Gilgit−Baltistan Scouts uniforms, stormed a high-altitude mountaineering base camp and killed 11 people; 10 climbers and one local tourist guide. The climbers were from various countries, including Ukraine, China, Slovakia, Lithuania and Nepal.

en.t: The last of Syria's declared chemical weapons are shipped out for destruction

en.t: United Kingdom European Union membership referendum, 2016
en.s: The United Kingdom European Union membership referendum, also known as the EU referendum and the Brexit referendum, was a referendum that took place on Thursday 23 June 2016 in the United Kingdom and Gibraltar to gauge support for the country's continued membership in the European Union. The referendum result was not legally binding. The referendum resulted in an overall vote to leave the EU, by 51.9% on a national turnout of 72%, the highest ever turnout for a UK-wide referendum and also the highest turnout for any national vote since the 1992 General Election.

zh.s: 阿尔伯塔省埃德蒙顿-斯特拉斯科纳选区于2025年6月23日举行补选，填补前省长、前阿尔伯塔新民主党领袖蕾切尔·诺特利辞职留下的空缺。诺特利于2024年12月30日辞职。同日还举行埃德蒙顿-埃勒斯利和奥兹-迪兹伯里-三山选区补选。

en.s: A by-election took place on June 23, 2025 in the Albertan provincial riding of Edmonton-Ellerslie to replace Rod Loyola. It was held on the same day as by-elections in Edmonton-Strathcona and Olds-Didsbury-Three Hills.

zh.t: 2025年埃德蒙顿-埃勒斯利选区补选
zh.s: 阿尔伯塔省埃德蒙顿-埃勒斯利选区于2025年6月23日举行补选，选出罗德·洛约拉的继任者。同日还举行埃德蒙顿-斯特拉斯科纳和奥兹-迪兹伯里-三山选区补选。
